questions.question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1 Western Europe

2 Germany

3 Munich

4 Europe

5 Bavaria
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

4. Europe - This is the continent, the largest geographical entity in the given list.

1. Western Europe - A region within Europe.

2. Germany - A country within Western Europe.

5. Bavaria - A state within Germany.

3. Munich - A city within Bavaria.

So, the order would be: **4, 1, 2, 5, 3**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1) Some lamps are bulbs.

2) All bulbs are tubes.

3) Some tubes are pipes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All bulbs are pipes.

II. At least some lamps are tubes.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2189d6c9623c20318a37e47d68a00d60a163a587a8859801fe87e1459b99874.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bulbs are pipes → **Does not** **f**ollow (As all bulbs are tubes and some tubes are pipes. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. At least some lamps are tubes **→** Follow (As some lamps are bulbs and all bulbs are tubes. As whole bulbs comes in tubes and also have some part common with lamps, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. No art is a drawing.

II. Some drawings are paintings.

III. All sketches are paintings.

**Conclusions:**

I. No sketch is a drawing.

II. No painting is an art.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2df17d969a5c341bb694a52d623371aa568ac643e0386d148f2d4b21b08bf2fb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No sketch is a drawing → Does not follow (As some drawings are paintings and all sketches are paintings. As no direct relation is given between sketches and drawings, therefore it is false.)

II. No painting is an art → Does not follow (As no art is a drawing and some drawings are paintings. As no direct relation is given between art and paintings, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
